sets.name: Sakuga VFX
sets.summary: Plain controls that react like an anime cut: squash and overshoot on springs, drawn smoke, impact bursts and sound-effect lettering on one canvas over the page.
sets.summary_es: Controles normales que reaccionan como un corte de anime: aplastan y rebotan sobre muelles y lanzan humo, impactos y onomatopeyas dibujados en un lienzo sobre la página.
sets.palette_es: Papel blanco, efectos en dos tonos (blanco y lavanda con línea violeta), acentos rosa; variables --sk-*.

controls.use_when_es: Acción principal o secundaria: confirmar, enviar, guardar.
controls.avoid_when_es: Acciones destructivas sin confirmación aparte o botones que se pulsan muchas veces seguidas.
controls.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-button>.

controls.use_when_es: Un ajuste que se activa o desactiva y se aplica al momento.
controls.avoid_when_es: Opciones que solo valen al enviar un formulario; ahí va una casilla.
controls.description: A switch whose flip is 43 painted frames: the knob smears across, slams into the end, throws up a splash, and the track floods and settles. The frames are inside the file (about 500 KB). One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toggle>.

controls.use_when_es: Un valor numérico en un rango: volumen, brillo, precio máximo.
controls.avoid_when_es: Valores exactos que la persona debe teclear.
controls.description: A range slider whose thumb stretches and lags on a spring, with cumulus rolling up behind a fast drag and a crescent thrown ahead on release. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-slider>.

controls.use_when_es: Elegir varias opciones o aceptar algo en un formulario.
controls.avoid_when_es: Una sola opción excluyente; ahí va un grupo de radio.
controls.description: A checkbox that slashes: crescents swing round the box, crystals fly, the tick draws itself, and ズザッ lands in dotted letters. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-checkbox>.

controls.use_when_es: Una opción entre pocas, siempre visibles.
controls.avoid_when_es: Más de siete opciones; ahí va una lista desplegable.
controls.description: A radio group whose picked dot springs in with a fan of wedges, two puffs and a hollow ポン. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-radio>.

controls.use_when_es: Texto corto: nombre, búsqueda, correo.
controls.avoid_when_es: Texto largo o con formato; ahí va un área de texto.
controls.description: A text field that kicks up a puff of dust from the caret on every key. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-input>.

controls.use_when_es: Cambiar entre dos a cuatro secciones de una misma pantalla.
controls.avoid_when_es: Navegación entre páginas distintas o más de cuatro secciones.
controls.description: Tabs where the raised tab slides to the one you pick, stretching, and lands with wedges and a puff. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tabs>.

controls.use_when_es: Una tarea larga con avance conocido: subida, instalación.
controls.avoid_when_es: Esperas cortas o sin avance medible.
controls.description: A loading bar with a storm cloud riding its leading edge, pebbles lifting off the ground and ゴゴゴゴ; at the end a burst, ドン! and a check. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-progress>.

controls.use_when_es: Pedir una puntuación de uno a cinco.
controls.avoid_when_es: Encuestas con escalas distintas de cinco niveles.
controls.description: Five stars that pop in one after another, with wedges and a hollow ポン on the last; five gets a burst. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-rating>.

controls.use_when_es: Confirmar algo que acaba de pasar: guardado, enviado.
controls.avoid_when_es: Errores que la persona debe leer con calma; ahí va un mensaje en la página.
controls.description: A notification that streaks in as a smear, lands in dust with ズザッ, wobbles and leaves by shrinking. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toast>.

controls.use_when_es: Una explicación breve junto a un control poco evidente.
controls.avoid_when_es: Información imprescindible: no puede depender de pasar el cursor.
controls.description: A help button whose hint springs out like a speech bubble, with puffs and a hollow カチッ. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tooltip>.

sets.name: Rubber Hose UI
sets.summary: Eleven ordinary controls as a 1930s rubber-hose cartoon: every control is a character.
sets.summary_es: Once controles normales como dibujos animados de 1930: cada control es un personaje.
sets.palette_es: Papel crema, tinta negra, rojo y azul de dibujo animado.

controls.use_when_es: Acción principal o secundaria: confirmar, enviar, guardar.
controls.avoid_when_es: Acciones destructivas sin confirmación aparte o botones que se pulsan muchas veces seguidas.
controls.description: A button who is a red dome with a grin. Press him and a gloved fist comes down and flattens him, with stars and BOP!; let go and he springs back black-eyed and bandaged, with birds going round his head. One file of about 208 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-button>.

controls.use_when_es: Un ajuste que se activa o desactiva y se aplica al momento.
controls.avoid_when_es: Opciones que solo valen al enviar un formulario; ahí va una casilla.
controls.description: A switch whose knob is a lightbulb. Off, he is grey and half asleep. Switch it on and he stretches across like taffy, lights up, and throws his fists in the air under a ring of rays, with CLICK!. One file of about 160 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-toggle>.

controls.use_when_es: Un valor numérico en un rango: volumen, brillo, precio máximo.
controls.avoid_when_es: Valores exactos que la persona debe teclear.
controls.description: A slider who is a trombone. His slide is the track and his own gloved hand on its handle is the thumb. Notes come out of the bell while it moves, and a fast pull gets a TOOT!. One file of about 140 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-slider>.

controls.use_when_es: Elegir varias opciones o aceptar algo en un formulario.
controls.avoid_when_es: Una sola opción excluyente; ahí va un grupo de radio.
controls.description: A checkbox who is a square fellow with a blank front. Tick him and his own arm swings round and slaps the check mark on, with ink flying and SPLAT!. Untick him and he wipes it off in a puff. One file of about 133 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-checkbox>.

controls.use_when_es: Una opción entre pocas, siempre visibles.
controls.avoid_when_es: Más de siete opciones; ahí va una lista desplegable.
controls.description: A radio group of round faces, one to a choice. The chosen one is blue, wide awake and bouncing; the others are cream and dozing off. Pick a sleeper and he pops awake with POP! while the last one nods off. One file of about 116 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-radio>.

controls.use_when_es: Texto corto: nombre, búsqueda, correo.
controls.avoid_when_es: Texto largo o con formato; ahí va un área de texto.
controls.description: A text field with a fountain pen standing on it. His nib sits on the caret: he goes wherever the caret goes, hops when a letter lands and flicks ink off his nib. One file of about 95 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-input>.

controls.use_when_es: Cambiar entre dos a cuatro secciones de una misma pantalla.
controls.avoid_when_es: Navegación entre páginas distintas o más de cuatro secciones.
controls.description: Folder tabs on a rail. The active one is alive: he stands up out of the rail with his fists in the air and his legs kicking underneath. Pick another and the first drops back while the new one pops up. One file of about 120 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-tabs>.

controls.use_when_es: Una tarea larga con avance conocido: subida, instalación.
controls.avoid_when_es: Esperas cortas o sin avance medible.
controls.description: A loading bar who is a thermometer lying on his side, propped up on his hands. The red climbs his tube while he strains and sweats; at a hundred he lets out a PHEW! and throws his fists up. One file of about 146 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-progress>.

controls.use_when_es: Pedir una puntuación de uno a cinco.
controls.avoid_when_es: Encuestas con escalas distintas de cinco niveles.
controls.description: Five stars in a chorus line. The ones you have given are yellow, laughing and kicking in time; the rest are pale and asleep. They wake one after another when the score goes up, with POP!. One file of about 113 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-rating>.

controls.use_when_es: Confirmar algo que acaba de pasar: guardado, enviado.
controls.avoid_when_es: Errores que la persona debe leer con calma; ahí va un mensaje en la página.
controls.description: A notification who is a toaster. Call show() and he hops up, braces, shakes, and a slice of toast with the message written on it jumps out of his slot, with DING!. One file of about 174 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-toast>.

controls.use_when_es: Una explicación breve junto a un control poco evidente.
controls.avoid_when_es: Información imprescindible: no puede depender de pasar el cursor.
controls.description: A help button with a bird behind it. Point at the question mark, focus it or tap it, and the bird pops up towing the hint on a balloon, with TWEET!. One file of about 130 KB with its drawings inside it, no dependencies, defines <hose-tooltip>.

sets.name: Pixel Worlds
sets.summary: Controls with a small living pixel-art scene inside: the control's value drives the scene. Painted in code, no images.
sets.summary_es: Controles con una pequeña escena de pixel art dentro: el valor del control mueve la escena. Pintado en código, sin imágenes.
sets.palette_es: Pixel art pintado en código, fondo pergamino.

controls.use_when_es: Mostrar qué hace un agente: pensando, buscando, leyendo, escribiendo.
controls.avoid_when_es: Procesos que no son un agente.
controls.description: Agent thinking states as a status chip: a pixel-art wizard at his desk who does whatever the agent is doing. One file, no dependencies, defines <sage-status>.

controls.title_es: Botón de borrar con pulsación larga
controls.use_when_es: Borrar algo que no se puede deshacer: la pulsación larga hace de confirmación.
controls.avoid_when_es: Acciones reversibles.
controls.demo: <hoard-button heading="Borrar este proyecto" warning="No se puede deshacer."></hoard-button>
controls.description: A hold-to-delete button with a pixel-art dragon in it. Hold and the fire is the fill; hold to the end and it fires hoard:delete. One file, no dependencies, defines <hoard-button>.
controls.a11y_note_es: Se alcanza con Tab pero no cambia nada a la vista al enfocarlo: añade un contorno :focus-visible propio en la página que lo use.

controls.use_when_es: Enviar un mensaje con un vuelo como progreso.
controls.avoid_when_es: Envíos instantáneos.
controls.description: A send button with a pixel-art raven in it. He carries the message across the button to a tower window, and that flight is the progress. One file, no dependencies, defines <raven-send>.
controls.a11y_note_es: Se alcanza con Tab pero no cambia nada a la vista al enfocarlo: añade un contorno :focus-visible propio en la página que lo use.

controls.use_when_es: Una espera larga y conocida en una web de juego o fantasía.
controls.avoid_when_es: Interfaces de trabajo serias.
controls.description: A loading bar that is the bar of a tavern: seven pixel-art regulars empty their cups in turn as the task loads. One file, no dependencies, defines <round-bar>.

controls.use_when_es: Un alta de cuenta donde la fuerza de la contraseña se ve como un castillo.
controls.avoid_when_es: Pantallas de acceso de uso diario, donde estorba.
controls.description: A password field where strength is a castle: each keystroke builds more of it, and a raccoon tests what you built. One file, no dependencies, defines <keep-field>.

controls.use_when_es: Un indicador pequeño y redondo, con valor o sin él.
controls.avoid_when_es: Cuando basta una rueda sencilla.
controls.description: A loading spinner that is a summoning circle cut into slate-blue stone, with a wisp for a light. With no value the wisp circles the ring; give it a value and the runes charge one by one; at 100% something answers. One file, no dependencies, defines <sigil-spinner>.
